mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, login_failed_count AS loginFailedCount, account_locked AS accountLocked, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM login WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.update: UPDATE login SET login_failed_count = #{loginFailedCount}, account_locked = #{accountLocked}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE username = #{username}
UPDATE login SET login_failed_count = 0, account_locked = false, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE username = #{username}
UPDATE login SET password = #{password}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE username = #{username}
